theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁ with
  | refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  | par ha hb =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    | par ha' hb' =>
      obtain ⟨a₃, ha⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha ha'
      obtain ⟨b₃, hb⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb hb'
      exact ⟨a₃ ⬝ b₃, .par ha.1 hb.1, .par ha.2 hb.2⟩
    | red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible _ ha]
      exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩

      rw [ha.2]
      exact ⟨a₃, .red_K a₃ _, ha.1⟩

      obtain ⟨a₃, b₃, ha⟩ := Sab_irreducible a b _ ha
      rw [ha.2.2]
